reference_boundary: OpenAI product docs are used only as official reference material. This manifest defines platform-neutral ADK runner contracts and does not include compatibility bindings.

quality_gates: runner adapters identify their client or adapter before starting work
machine-consumed output uses JSONL or a strict output schema
sandbox and approval policy are recorded for each run
resume and reply paths preserve threadId correlation
failure, cancellation or blocked status is observable and not collapsed into success
must_not: expose API keys or auth files to repository-controlled code
use danger-full-access or approval never as an unreviewed default
treat free-form final prose as machine-readable runner evidence
hide app-server experimental fields behind stable contracts

contracts.purpose: Start a bounded agent runtime session from an MCP client or local orchestration layer.
contracts.approval_boundary: approval-policy must be recorded and cannot silently widen sandbox access
contracts.sandbox_boundary: sandbox must be read-only, workspace-write, or danger-full-access with explicit evidence

contracts.purpose: Continue an existing agent runtime session.
contracts.approval_boundary: approval prompts must carry the same threadId for audit correlation
contracts.sandbox_boundary: inherits original session boundary unless explicitly reconfigured and audited
